title: Apple releases security updates
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-300.032520: TT-CSIRT ADVISORY- APPLE RELEASES SECURITY UPDATES
leadParagraph: Apple has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in multiple products. An attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system.
contentHtml:
Apple has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in multiple products. An attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system.

The Trinidad and Tobago Cyber Security Incident Response Team (CSIRT) encourages users and administrators to review the Apple security pages for the following products and apply the necessary updates:

  • iTunes 12.10.5 for Windows: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT211105
  • iOS 13.4 and iPadOS 13.4: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT211102
  • Safari 13.1: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT211104
  • watchOS 6.2: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT211103
  • tvOS 13.4: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT211101
  • macOS Catalina 10.15.4, Security Update 2020-002 Mojave, Security Update 2020-002 High Sierra: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT211100
  • Xcode 11.4: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT211108
